description: Use the project owner admin key (ga_...) to invite a named viewer, approver or admin. Returns a single-use invite link shown once, expiring after 72 hours; send it to that person. They accept it to receive their member key, also shown once. Gate sends no email.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_invite_member
title: Invite a team member
